The Market This Week - Nov 13 to Nov 19

Rates first: the 30-year fixed averaged 7.28% as of Nov 19 (Freddie Mac), up from 7.11%. Homes going under contract: down 15.3% nationally from a year ago, the lowest in Redfin's records going back to 2021 (Redfin, four weeks ending Nov 15); in the Atlanta area, October contracts were down 26.8% from a year ago (Georgia MLS). Local: Spalding County tax bills carry a new stormwater fee, $60 a year up to 6,000 sq ft and $90 from 6,000 to 9,000, first-year discount up to 38% (Griffin Daily News, Nov 12), and the state's one-time tax relief grant takes $18,000 off assessed value for tax year 2026. General information from the sources named, for the dates shown. Not tax, legal or loan advice. Your own tax bill depends on your county and your own situation. Check with your county tax office.
